Customer: Thank you, I appreciate that. It literally happens like clockwork between half seven and ten o'clock at night while I'm trying to stream or finish work calls.
Agent: So if I've got that right, your daytime service is stable, but every night between roughly seven thirty and ten your fibre connection keeps cutting out completely—is that accurate?
Customer: Yes, spot on. During the day while I'm working from home on spreadsheets it's mostly fine, maybe a tiny dip, but in the evening it completely dies.
Agent: Got it, thank you for confirming that. Before I pull up your live line telemetry, could you confirm the first line of your address and your four-digit security PIN?
Customer: Sure, the first line is 14 Meadowcroft Lane, Guildford, and my four-digit PIN is 7392.

Customer: Yes please, it's twelve pounds for the seven-day pass, isn't it?
Agent: Because you have a multi-SIM family discount on S-Net, the second Roam-Further pass is actually discounted by twenty percent to nine pounds sixty, added to your next monthly bill.
Customer: Oh, nine pounds sixty is even better! Yes, please schedule that for Sunday morning for her.

Agent: Just so you know, your 25 gigabyte Roam-Further allowance resets on your billing date and has no daily throttling across Spain.
Customer: That's a huge relief, Hannah, honestly I thought I was going to have to hunt for airport café Wi-Fi with all my luggage.
Agent: I'm so glad we caught both that old switch flag and the legacy APN setting so you can get straight to your hotel, Kwame.
Customer: You've been brilliant, really quick and straight to the point.

Customer: Everything is working 100 percent now, nothing else needed at all.
Agent: Wonderful. Thank you for choosing S-Net, Kwame, and have a fantastic trip in Valencia!
Customer: Thanks Hannah, cheers, bye!
